specName: 022 Generic Work Center — Temp-to-Live Conversion and Verification
expectations: re-deciding a screen's approved presentation: a disagreement is resolved in the chunk that owns that screen
verifying a deferred chunk's screen beyond its unavailable presentation
changing runtime behaviour beyond removing the temporary material and proving the live presentations
context: spec: 015-generic-wc-ui-shell owns the Temp naming rule and the guard this chunk tightens to zero
spec: 016 to 021 own the screens, live sources and deletions this chunk verifies
constraint: every data operation goes through a stored procedure (constitution III)
constraint: no demo/mock mode may exist, and RetiredSymbolAuditTests fails the build if one returns
area: MTM_Waitlist.Tests/Module_GenericRequest/TempArtefactBoundaryAuditTests.cs already carries the boundary check
area: repository docs tree carries no per-screen verification record yet

FR-001.title: After this chunk the solution MUST contain no Temp artefact belonging to this feature, checked across source, XAML, resources, project files, configuration and database artefacts

FR-002.title: Where the preview project is retained it MUST be the only place the Temp naming appears and MUST stay unreachable from the shipped application

FR-003.title: A build-time check MUST fail, naming the offending artefact, if any Temp artefact appears in the reported scope

FR-004.title: The check's exemptions MUST be listed one at a time, never by pattern

FR-005.title: The application MUST build, start and reach the board after every removal, with nothing dangling

FR-006.title: No Temp artefact MAY be renamed into a permanent-looking name instead of being replaced or deleted

FR-007.title: Any Temp database artefact MUST be dropped by its own artifact in the same change, touching no other store

FR-008.title: Each screen MUST present on its live source the same populated, empty and unavailable presentations approved on preview

FR-009.title: The unavailable presentation MUST carry the time of the attempt and a retry control on every screen

FR-010.title: The generic card MUST draw from a live request the same cells in the same places as the approved variant, and no unapproved cell

FR-011.title: Awkward real values MUST render exactly as the preview scenarios proved them

FR-012.title: The whole flow MUST remain walkable end to end on live data, by the same controls, with no dead end

FR-013.title: Every disagreement between approved preview and live presentation MUST be recorded and resolved before completion

FR-014.title: Every screen's verification MUST be recorded individually, naming the screen, the presentations compared and the outcome

FR-015.title: A chunk that has not shipped MUST leave its screen reporting the answer source unavailable from a live check

FR-016.title: A deferred chunk MUST leave no Temp artefact and MUST NOT change any other screen's behaviour

FR-017.title: A deferred chunk, when it later ships, MUST make its screen work without any other screen being edited

intent: Prove the temporary preview material is gone and each generic work center screen still behaves on live data as the owner approved

decisions.decision: Scan every project the solution names, not just the application's reference graph
decisions.why: FR-001 speaks about the solution, and the deleted preview project no longer bounds the risk
decisions.rejected: keeping the reference-graph scan, which cannot see a Temp artefact in the tests or deployment tools

decisions.decision: Keep the guard's own file name and exempt it by exact path
decisions.why: FR-004 wants exemptions that can be read one at a time; renaming a guard to dodge its own rule hides the rule
decisions.rejected: renaming the audit to avoid the prefix

decisions.decision: Allow an exemption keyed by exact path plus exact declared name
decisions.why: TempRootFixture means a temporary directory and the rest of its file must stay checked
decisions.rejected: exempting the whole file, or renaming an unrelated fixture

decisions.decision: Exempt TemporaryCredentialAttemptLimitTests.cs rather than narrowing the file-name rule
decisions.why: narrowing to Temp[A-Z] would stop catching a TempSomething.cs artefact, the shape this feature's material took

decisions.decision: Put the per-screen record in the feature directory as verification.md
decisions.why: spec assumption A4 puts the evidence with the feature documentation, as 018 did with wording.md
decisions.rejected: a page under docs, or a JSON manifest read by a test

decisions.decision: Cite the tests the owning chunks already ship as each screen's evidence
decisions.why: a second copy of the same assertions is evidence that can drift from the first
decisions.rejected: a new end-to-end UI test per screen, which needs a review host that no longer exists

decisions.decision: Read the project list from MTM_Waitlist.sln rather than globbing *.csproj
decisions.why: FR-001 speaks about the solution, and the solution file is what states it
decisions.rejected: a directory walk, which would also scan scratch projects nobody considers part of the solution

decisions.decision: Structured offences with a kind, so an exemption can match one declaration
decisions.why: TempRootFixture is a temporary directory, and the rest of its file must stay checked
decisions.rejected: path-only exemptions, which would stop checking whole files

decisions.decision: Add one unreadable-source test each for the work center and summary steps
decisions.why: FR-014 needs evidence per screen, and those two had none for the unavailable presentation
decisions.rejected: recording the unavailable presentation as proven by the shared base class alone

specify.summary: Widen the Temp boundary audit to the whole solution with exact reasoned exemptions, and record one verification entry per screen from the tests that already prove it
specify.key_finding: the guard already exists and is clean, but it only walks the application's reference graph, so a Temp artefact parked in the tests or the deployment tools would go unnoticed
